description: This file contains the Coupon model class for the Opencart admin marketing module. It manages CRUD operations for coupons, including adding, editing, deleting coupons, associating coupons with products and categories, and retrieving coupon data and histories.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Model class for managing marketing coupons within Opencart admin module. Provides methods to create, update, delete, and retrieve coupons and their associations with products and categories.

methods.name: addCoupon
methods.description: Creates a new coupon record in the database, including associating products and categories if provided.

methods.name: editCoupon
methods.description: Updates an existing coupon record and its associated products and categories.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the active/inactive status of a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCoupon
methods.description: Deletes a coupon and its related product, category, and history records.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves a coupon record by its primary key.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a coupon record by its unique code.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coupons with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all product associations for a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProductsByProductId
methods.description: Removes product associations by product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all product IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a category with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Removes all category associations for a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Removes category associations by category ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all category IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total count of coupons in the database.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves coupon usage histories with pagination.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records for a coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total count of history records for a coupon.
